item.title: Write a Note for a Dog Walker
item.prompt_text: Your dog is called Pip. Kim is coming to take Pip for a short walk. Pip's lead is on the blue chair. Ask Kim to put it back in the same place. Write a note for Kim.
item.target_grammar: Is for location and please plus a verb.
item.target_structure: Name the dog, give the location, and explain where the lead goes after the walk.

checklist.point: Ask Kim to return it to that place.
keywords: leave it on the same chair
